cause: Acquisition records requested view_pose/index before arm-clearance accepts it. Clearance abandons the pending scan; acquisition requires exact issued servo match to advance, never reissues same index, so waits indefinitely.
action: Scoped SIGINT, counted as failure, raw ARM verified. No same-source resubmission.
scope: Cause supported by final trace, issued-command/frame history and source. Does not explain all unsuccessful color trials.
